name: barbell reverse grip bent over row
description: A bent-over row with an underhand grip. Targets the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing forward, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and soften your knees.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang straight.
Pull the bar to your lower belly, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower the bar with control.
